presets.name: SSC (CGL / CHSL / MTS)
presets.notes: The photograph is no longer uploaded: it is taken live with the webcam or the mySSC app during the application. Only the signature is uploaded.

documents.label: Signature
documents.note: About 6.0 × 2.0 cm. Blurred or tiny signatures are rejected.

presets.name: UPSC (Civil Services and others)
presets.notes: A live photo is also captured during the application and must match the uploaded one. The pixel sizes here are the app's choice; UPSC gives only KB limits.
presets.source: UPSC online application photo/signature instructions, 2026 cycle (via secondary sources)

documents.label: Photograph
documents.note: Recent, plain white background, face at least 75% of the frame, both ears visible.

documents.label: Signature (three times)
documents.note: Sign three times, one below the other, in black ink on white paper, and photograph all three together.

presets.name: IBPS (PO / Clerk)
presets.notes: A live photo is also captured during the application. The clerk notification has used the same sizes as PO in recent cycles.
presets.source: IBPS CRP PO/MT-XVI notification (2026), Annexure III

documents.label: Photograph
documents.note: Recent colour photo, light (preferably white) background, no cap or dark glasses.

documents.label: Signature
documents.note: Black ink on white paper, not in capital letters.

documents.label: Left thumb impression
documents.note: Black or blue ink on white paper, 3 × 3 cm.

documents.label: Handwritten declaration
documents.note: In English, black ink, not in capitals: "I, (name), hereby declare that all the information submitted by me in the application form is correct, true and valid. I will present the supporting documents as and when required."

presets.name: SBI (PO / Clerk)
presets.notes: A live photo is also captured during the application. Keep a few prints of the same photo for later stages.
presets.source: SBI PO advertisement CRPD/PO/2026-27/09 (18-06-2026), Annexure II

documents.label: Photograph
documents.note: Recent colour photo, light (preferably white) background.

documents.label: Signature
documents.note: Black ink on white paper, not in capital letters.

documents.label: Left thumb impression
documents.note: Black or blue ink on white paper.

documents.label: Handwritten declaration
documents.note: In English, black ink: "I (name), (date of birth) hereby declare that all the information submitted by me in the application form is correct, true and valid. I will present the supporting documents as and when required. The signature, photograph and left-hand thumb impression is of mine."

presets.name: RRB (NTPC and other CENs)
presets.notes: Recent RRB applications take the photo live with the webcam or phone, so only the signature is uploaded. Older CENs asked for a 30-70 KB photo upload; check your CEN.

documents.label: Signature
documents.note: At least 140 × 60 px, black ink, running hand, not in capitals.

presets.name: NEET UG
presets.notes: NTA gives only KB limits; the pixel sizes are the app's choice. A live photo is also captured. The postcard-size photo is only needed as prints, not as an upload.

documents.label: Passport-size photo
documents.note: Face about 80% of the photo with ears visible, white background, taken recently (the bulletin sets a cut-off date).

documents.label: Left-hand fingers and thumb
documents.note: The bulletin gives both 10-200 KB and 50-300 KB; 50-200 KB satisfies both.

documents.label: Right-hand fingers and thumb
documents.note: The bulletin gives both 10-200 KB and 50-300 KB; 50-200 KB satisfies both.

presets.name: JEE Main
presets.notes: NTA gives only KB limits; the pixel sizes are the app's choice. A live photo is also captured.

documents.label: Photograph
documents.note: Recent colour photo, face about 80% with ears visible, white background.

presets.name: CUET UG
presets.notes: NTA gives only KB limits; the pixel sizes are the app's choice. Note the lower signature limit than NEET and JEE.

documents.label: Photograph
documents.note: Recent colour photo, face about 80% with ears visible, white background.

presets.name: GATE
presets.notes: The organising IIT changes every year; these are the GATE 2026 (IIT Guwahati) rules.

documents.label: Photograph
documents.note: 200 × 260 to 530 × 690 px, face 60-70% of the frame, white background. Spectacles allowed, not sunglasses.

documents.label: Signature
documents.note: 250 × 80 to 580 × 180 px, black or dark blue ink, signature filling 70-80% of the image.

presets.name: Passport size (35 × 45 mm)
presets.notes: 35 × 45 mm at 300 DPI, for printing or for forms that just say "passport size". Passport Seva itself photographs you at the Kendra and publishes no upload limits.

documents.label: Passport photo
documents.note: Plain white background, face centred, both ears visible.

presets.name: Generic form
presets.notes: Common sizes used by many state and recruitment portals. If your form lists exact numbers, save a custom preset instead.
